A '''Human Jedi''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survived the initial execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] commanding [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Death/Legends|execute]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. She evaded the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] she was accompanying by taking advantage of the fog where she was stationed. Eventually she was among several Jedi who were captured and brought to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], alias the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious, who gave them [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and encouraged them to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] each other. The Jedi instead attacked Sidious, who killed all of them except for her and the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] Jedi [[Beyghor Sahdett]]. Sahdett, overpowered by his awe and fear of Sidious, then turned on the Jedi and killed her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|If you had been there, if you had ''seen''&hellip;you would have done what I did. You ''would'' have done the same! You might still!|Beyghor Sahdett to Jedi Master Kai Hudorra, on allying with the Sith and killing the Human Jedi|<ref name="SWDT 30" />}}
[[File:Swonrep79p2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Jedi evades capture.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="SWR 79" /> which began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> alongside [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="SWR 79" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="DateOrder66">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], during which the prologue of [[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]] is set, to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Jedi was with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] near a set of ruins. Her [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which was a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] commanding the Republic forces to [[Death/Legends|execute]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] as traitors. When the clones attacked the Jedi, she managed to evade them due to the extremely thick fog, which prevented them from locating her position and killing her.<ref name="SWR 79" />

Around 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she, alongside four other Jedi, including the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Beyghor Sahdett]], was eventually captured, starved and beaten. Soon, the Jedi were brought before [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine himself, whom they recognized to be a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]], Darth Sidious. The Emperor handed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to the Jedi and her fellow [[Prisoner/Legends|captives]], encouraging them to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] one another for the right to survive under his rule. The Jedi had not given in to fear, however, and attacked the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as one, yet Sidious' prowess with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and a lightsaber allowed him to kill three of the Jedi in an instant. She and Sahdett were the only two left standing, shocked at how quickly their compatriots had been slaughtered. Sahdett, however, enraptured by awe and fear of Sidious' power, turned on the Jedi and rammed his blade through her [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]], killing her.<ref name="SWDT 30" /> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> when Sahdett&mdash;who had become an agent of the Sith&mdash;was later captured by surviving [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]], he attempted to justify his actions by explaining the encounter with Palpatine where he killed the human Jedi.<ref name="SWDT 30" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:WWJediDeath.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Jedi is killed by Beyghor Sahdett.]]
The Jedi was light-skinned<ref name="SWDT 30" /> with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="SWR 79" /> and dark red [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. Along with the other captive Jedi, she refused for them to duel each other upon Darth Sidious' encouragement, and instead attacked the Sith Lord, though they were no match for Sidious' power.<ref name="SWDT 30" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Jedi was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was able to escape being executed during the initial stages of Order 66.<ref name="SWR 79" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi wore a set of brown and gray [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]<ref name="SWR 79" /> and owned a blue lightsaber.<ref name="SWDT 30" /> She also adorned her forehead with a simple tiara containing a red [[Stone/Legends|stone]] at its center.<ref name="SWR 79" /> At the time of her capture, she was wearing a different tiara, with a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] stone at the center.<ref name="SWDT 30" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi first appeared in the [[Republic 79|seventy-ninth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[Randy Stradley]] under the pseudonym "Welles Hartley," penciled by [[Douglas Wheatley]],<ref name="SWR 79" /> and released on [[November 9]], [[2005]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/10-446/Star-Wars-Republic-79|text=STAR WARS: REPUBLIC #79}}</ref>

She later reappeared in [[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 3|''Dark Times—A Spark Remains'' 3]], a comic authored by Stradley<ref name="SWDT 30" /> and published on [[September 18]], [[2013]],<ref name="DH2">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/22-249/Star-Wars-Dark-Times-A-Spark-Remains-3|text=STAR WARS: DARK TIMES&mdash;A SPARK REMAINS #3}}</ref> with a somewhat different appearance.<ref name="SWDT 30" /> Nonetheless, Stradley confirmed it was indeed the same character, and her addition to that comic was in response to some fans' thoughts of too many surviving Jedi in the ''Republic'' comic series.<ref name="Forums">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=21165|thread=Wonder Woman Jedi|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2013-09-29|time=11:20 pm}}</ref>
